_comment: A lone block of 140 Spearmen (9 files of 16, close order, 9 wu pitch) facing east, doubled to 18 files of 8 by the alternate-rank explicatio (Polyaenus, Stratagems 2.10.4) read files first: Alt+B steps the drill to the alternate rank, Alt+Ctrl+Shift+B steps the opening from together to files first, and a plain B deals it. Each old file opens out to its distance from the middle file outward with every man still in it, each man keeping his place behind the man ahead of him in it, read from where they stand, and only once its file leader settles does its every second man step into the interval beside the man ahead of him and come up, each man once the man ahead of him has settled and passed the word back, or stepped out (the word passing back a man at a time is the sim's inference) (Bingham's note on Aelian 29.3: the doubling must be done in open order, the files standing apart when the men march up between them; doing the opening first is the sim's inference). explicatio_following counts the men still following: 136 at tick 120, while the files open, 49 at tick 900, 21 at tick 1200, 1 at tick 1410, and null from tick 1440, the files opening a man at a time down each file as the word passes back. The front rank keeps its line at x 587.5 and the block settles at [556.04, 384.5]. Measured 2026-11-20 on FULL dumps every 30 ticks to tick 1800 (seed run 0) and at the state ticks on seed runs 0 to 4, which play out identically (no enemy, no roll). On main, which has no opening reading, Alt+Ctrl+Shift+B steps the side to inward instead, so the block settles at y 375.5, and the dump has no explicatio_following, so those expects fail there. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).

misslotted.reason: #1995: misslotted reads men still in a drill as swapped. Files first, a man waiting in his unopened old file stands behind the man ahead of him in it, as the reading means, not behind the man the dumped relations name: those are the finished grid's (DemoState.relations), so while the block stands still with men still waiting the misslot reading counts them as swapped. Measured 2026-11-20 on each of seed runs 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 alike: 0.936 of the men at tick 1140, 0.929 at 1200, 0.079 at 1260, 0.036 at 1320, 0.007 at 1380, and 0 at every other state tick, once the drill ends too; an exemption cannot name a tick window.
